Definition: of uncertain affinity; to belch, i.e. (figuratively) to speak out:--utter.
BiblicalUsage: Ereúgomai means to utter — to speak out, as a spring bubbles up. It occurs just once, where Jesus says He will utter things kept secret from the foundation of the world. The word is speech pouring out of a full heart.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ereúgomai is a word for how Jesus speaks: what has been hidden pours out, like water from a spring.
